character: A very large resort in south-west Montana built around Lone Peak, whose summit is reached by a tram, with terrain spread across several connected mountains and a vertical of over 4,000 ft. Steep expert terrain sits up high, with groomed intermediate runs lower down.
learning: Reference note: learning terrain is near the Mountain Village base, and lessons run through the resort's ski and ride school. Confirm current learning lifts, carpets and lesson products.
